# Deliberate breaking API changes CI allows, one per line, copied from the
# oasdiff error or warning (see "apps/library" in AGENTS.md). Empty unless a
# removal is under review.

# FIT-558: a Plan's goal, place, experience level and workout duration are
# optional (ADR 0017), so every response carrying a Plan answers them as
# nullable. Safe because MIN_APP_VERSION is 2.6.1 (FIT-556), the first release
# whose build shows an unset Plan detail cleanly; every older build is cut off
# by the minimum version gate. Empty this file again in the follow-up once
# this is on `main`.
GET /v1/plans the response property `data/items/experience_level` became nullable for the status `200`
GET /v1/plans the response property `data/items/goal` became nullable for the status `200`
GET /v1/plans the response property `data/items/place` became nullable for the status `200`
GET /v1/plans the response property `data/items/workout_duration` became nullable for the status `200`
